name: Itazura Mamono to Scapegoat
original_name: いたずらマモノとスケープゴート
source:
Human sacrifices wanted to be loved.
A human-eating demon wanted to love.

Now, as an apology for the tricks, here's my sweet heart!

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24222]Freem![/url]]
translation:
人祭渴望被愛。
食人的妖魔，渴望去愛。

那麼，就用我這顆甜蜜的心，為那些惡作劇賠罪吧！

[譯自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24222]Freem![/url]]
